The target is estimated based on 9 provinces being offered biannual stakeholder consultations and dialogues but the risk is present of limited political will to convene these dialogues. Therefore target is set at 36 to make realistic.

title.narrative: Score (110) based on the degree to which the political leadership recognises the value of, and enables, participation by civil society in policymaking processes

description.narrative: Calculate the score for each country of implementations (from 1 to 10) using the following guidelines: 1 The political leadership obstructs civil society participation. It suppresses civil society organizations and excludes its representatives from the policy process. 2 choose this scoring if the situation is no represented by the definition associated with scoring 1 or 4, but is closer to the definition of score 1 3 choose this scoring if the situation is no represented by the definition associated with scoring 1 or 4, but is closer to the definition of score 4 4 The political leadership neglects civil society participation. It frequently ignores civil society actors and formulates its policy autonomously. 5 choose this scoring if the situation is no represented by the definition associated with scoring 4 or 7, but is closer to the definition of score 4 6 choose this scoring if the situation is no represented by the definition associated with scoring 4 or 7, but is closer to the definition of score 7 7 The political leadership permits civil society participation. It takes into account and accommodates the interests of most civil society actors. 8 choose this scoring if the situation is no represented by the definition associated with scoring 7 or 10, but is closer to the definition of score 7 9 choose this scoring if the country context is no represented by the definition associated with scoring 7 or 10, but is closer to the definition of score 10 10 The Political Leadership actively enables civil society participation. It assigns an important role to civil society actors in deliberating and determining policies.The cutoff score above which its considered that the political leadership recognizes the value of and enables the participation of civil society is 7

comment.narrative: Through this Project UNICEF in consultation with national and provincial governments will convene social services decentralization dialogue which will provide platform for civil society women youth and other actors to participate in the discussions at all levels leading to the decisionmaking on the delivery of social services affecting them.
